name: Sales summary
pitch: Summarizes three months of sales data and identifies the biggest trend.
instructions: Read the spreadsheet to find the sales figures for the last three months. Calculate the month‑on‑month change for each metric. Identify which metric had the largest increase or decrease. Create a simple table with the three months and the key figures. If the spreadsheet has no data, say so and stop. If a calculation fails, report the error plainly. Show the table to the person at the end.

examples.ask: can you look at my sales spreadsheet?
examples.does: read the file and list the sheet names

skills.name: extract-sales-figures
skills.description: read the spreadsheet and pull the numbers for the last three months
skills.body: 1. Use file_read to open the spreadsheet. 2. Locate the sheet or section with monthly sales. 3. Extract the total sales figure for each of the last three months. 4. If a month is missing, note it and continue with the available months.

readme:
# Sales summary
Summarizes the last three months of sales data from a spreadsheet and spots the biggest trend.

**What it needs**: file_read to open the spreadsheet, shell_run for any calculations, show_table to display the results.

**What it will not do**: it cannot interpret business strategy, it only reports the numbers it finds.
